init.title: General settings
init.description: Configure the general behavior, then the 4000K and 1000K visual references. White channel settings appear automatically for selected RGBW or RGB+CCT lights. For immediate light previews while editing, open the Circadian Pro panel.

data.take_over_control: Give up control on manual changes

data_description.lights: Lights controlled by this profile. You can leave the list empty.
data_description.interval: How often settings are recalculated and applied.
data_description.transition: Transition time during regular adaptation. Sleep mode has its own transition setting.
data_description.initial_transition: Transition time for the first change when turning on a light.
data_description.sleep_rgb_or_color_temp: How color is defined in sleep mode.
data_description.sleep_color_temp: Sleep color temperature (if using color temperature).
data_description.sleep_rgb_color: Sleep RGB color (if using RGB). In this mode the W channel is forced to 0.
data_description.sleep_transition: Transition time when enabling/disabling sleep mode.
data_description.sleep_schedule_start:
Start of the automatic schedule. Only used with “By schedule”.
Use HH:MM:SS; for example, 23:00:00.
data_description.sleep_schedule_end:
End of the automatic schedule. Only used with “By schedule”.
The schedule can cross midnight; for example, 23:00:00 to 05:00:00.
data_description.take_over_control: If enabled, pauses adaptation when manual changes are detected.
data_description.sunrise_offset_minutes: Adjust sunrise in whole minutes. Positive values delay it and negative values bring it forward. For example, 30 delays it by half an hour.
data_description.sunset_offset_minutes: Adjust sunset in whole minutes. Positive values delay it and negative values bring it forward. For example, 60 delays it by one hour.
data_description.sunrise_time: Use this sunrise time every day. Leave it empty to calculate sunrise from your location and the date.
data_description.min_sunrise_time: Prevent the profile sunrise from occurring before this time. Leave it empty to apply no lower limit.
data_description.max_sunrise_time: Prevent the profile sunrise from occurring after this time. Leave it empty to apply no upper limit.
data_description.sunset_time: Use this sunset time every day. Leave it empty to calculate sunset from your location and the date.
data_description.min_sunset_time: Prevent the profile sunset from occurring before this time. Leave it empty to apply no lower limit.
data_description.max_sunset_time: Prevent the profile sunset from occurring after this time. Leave it empty to apply no upper limit.
data_description.brightness_mode_time_dark:
Duration of the nighttime portion of the transition: before sunrise and after sunset.
Used only in Linear and Sigmoid modes. A higher value lengthens this portion; Natural ignores it.
data_description.brightness_mode_time_light:
Duration of the daytime portion of the transition: after sunrise and before sunset.
Used only in Linear and Sigmoid modes. A higher value lengthens this portion; Natural ignores it.
data_description.brightness_mode_time_dark_minutes:
Starts the increase earlier, before sunrise.
Extends the decrease after sunset.
Affects brightness and, when checked, temperature too.
data_description.brightness_mode_time_light_minutes:
Extends the increase after sunrise.
Starts the decrease earlier, before sunset.
Affects brightness and, when checked, temperature too.
data_description.sleep_activation_mode:
Disabled: sleep mode is activated only by its manual switch.
By sunrise and sunset: active between the profile sunset and sunrise.
By schedule: active during the schedule below.
The manual switch can activate sleep mode at any time.
data_description.autoreset_control_seconds: Time before Circadian Pro resumes control after a manual change. Use 0 to disable automatic resumption.
data_description.brightness_mode:
Natural: keeps maximum brightness during the day; at night, brightness falls and rises again towards sunrise. It does not apply to temperature, which follows its independent solar curve. It ignores the two transition times.
Linear: changes brightness at a constant rate. Each transition lasts the sum of the two times.
Sigmoid: uses an S curve, gentle at the ends and faster in the middle. The two times set the main part of the transition.
In Linear and Sigmoid, temperature also follows its solar curve unless you check “Also apply to temperature”.
In Linear and Sigmoid, each time accepts whole minutes from 0 to 240.
data_description.apply_temperature_curve: Shares the curve and timing between brightness and temperature, each within its own limits. This also replaces the nighttime temperature progression. Sleep mode keeps its own settings.

white_w_kelvin.title: White channel (W)
white_w_kelvin.description: Enter the real Kelvin of the dedicated white channel (W) of your RGBW strip (for example, 3000K).

data_description.white_w_kelvin: Actual Kelvin of the dedicated W (white) LED in your strip. From 4000K down to this value, the W channel stays at the 4000K level; below it, W is progressively reduced towards the 1000K calibration.

white_channels.title: Warm and cold white channels
white_channels.description: Enter the physical temperatures of the warm white (WW) and cold white (CW) LEDs in your RGB+CCT strip. These are hardware values, separate from the 4000K and 1000K visual references.

data_description.white_w_kelvin: Actual temperature of the warm white LED. The existing W value is preserved, normally 3000K. It must be lower than CW.
data_description.white_cw_kelvin: Actual temperature of the cold white LED, for example 6500K. If omitted in YAML or service settings, the light's maximum temperature is used, with 6500K as fallback.

cal_neutral.title: Calibration 4000K
cal_neutral.description: Adjust RGB for your 4000K visual reference. RGBW lights add one white intensity control; RGB+CCT lights also add the warm/cold white mixture temperature. The Circadian Pro panel provides an immediate preview while editing.

data_description.cal_white_intensity_neutral:
RGBW: W channel intensity.
RGB+CCT: total warm and cold white intensity, with the mixture set separately.
data_description.cal_white_kelvin_neutral: Temperature of the white mixture at the 4000K visual reference, between the physical WW and CW temperatures. RGB remains independently adjustable.

cal_warm.title: Calibration 1000K
cal_warm.description: Adjust RGB for your 1000K visual reference. White intensity appears only when a selected light supports RGBW or RGB+CCT; keeping it low lets RGB create a warm/orange appearance. The Circadian Pro panel provides an immediate preview while editing.

data_description.cal_white_intensity_warm: White intensity at the 1000K visual reference. In RGB+CCT, only warm white is used here; normally keep white low so RGB can produce the warm/orange appearance.

error.option_error: One or more options are invalid.
error.entity_missing: A configured light entity no longer exists.
error.invalid_brightness_range: Minimum brightness cannot be greater than maximum brightness.
error.invalid_color_temp_range: Minimum color temperature cannot be greater than maximum color temperature.
error.invalid_brightness_window: Transition times must be numbers greater than or equal to zero.
error.invalid_sunrise_bounds: Earliest sunrise cannot be later than latest sunrise.
error.invalid_sunset_bounds: Earliest sunset cannot be later than latest sunset.
error.invalid_white_channel_range: The warm white WW temperature must be lower than the cold white CW temperature.
error.invalid_white_neutral_range: The white mixture temperature must be between the physical warm white WW and cold white CW temperatures.
error.invalid_sleep_schedule: Set both a valid start and end time for the automatic sleep schedule.
error.invalid_solar_times: Fixed sunrise and sunset must occur at different times after applying their offsets.

abort.yaml_configuration: This profile is configured in YAML. Edit its settings in your YAML configuration.
